_note: The security-relevant subset, not the full Regulation. GDPR has 99 articles; the great majority concern data-subject rights, lawful bases, definitions and supervisory-authority procedure, which a configuration scan does not evidence and which are deliberately absent rather than reported as gaps. Scope chosen to match the articles gdpr_to_800_53 maps, extended to the sibling paragraphs of the same articles. A privacy adviser should confirm the scope before it is presented as a compliance denominator.
